// CASE swift_mwc_raw_string_comment expect=pass
func mapWithConcurrency(
  items: [Int], width: Int, operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async throws -> Void
) async throws {
  for offset in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items[offset..<min(offset + width, items.count)] {
        group.addTask { try await operation( /* #"it's "await""# \(await x) */item) }
      }
      try await group.waitForAll()
    }
  }
}
// CASE swift_inorder_multiline_comment expect=pass
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async rethrows {
  for item in items {
    try await step(
      item  // it's `await` "x"
    )
  }
}
// CASE swift_inorder_raw_interp_dup expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> String, reason: String) async rethrows {
  for item in items {
    log(try await step(item), #"\#(try await step(item))"#)
  }
}
// CASE swift_inorder_plain_interp_dup_control expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> String, reason: String) async rethrows {
  for item in items {
    log(try await step(item), "\(try await step(item))")
  }
}
